correctness.rationale: For the 18 arcs of the fully bidirected triangular prism, exact independent enumerations of all 2^18 masks give 687 augmented faces, f-vector by size (1,18,108,260,240,60); our new independent mod-2 boundary ranks are (17,91,164,54), giving reduced Betti (0,0,5,22,6). Inspected greedy acyclic matching certifies 326 Hasse pairs and critical counts one 0-cell, five 2-cells, 22 3-cells, six 4-cells; exact integral Morse projection has both d3 and d4 zero. Independently reconstructed integer matching, its Morse boundaries, five independent degree-two cocycles and six exact integral four-cycles; all 90 Alexander–Whitney cup evaluations (15 unordered H² pairings times six cycles) vanish. π3 of wedge of five S2 plus 22 S3 has Hopf and pairwise Whitehead components (15 total) plus 3-sphere degrees. Zero integer d4 and cup products imply all four-cell attaching maps null since relevant π3 is torsion-free. Therefore true integral wedge, not just Betti computation.
residual_risks: Exact finite homotopy deduction relies on the inspected acyclic matching and integer attaching-map chain/cup calculations, not only field Betti numbers.
